title: SEA Ecom Full-Stack Vendor Laizanbao Raises Multi-$10M Series B
summary: On Aug 17, 2022, SEA ecom full-stack vendor Laizanbao Group (来赞宝) (founded 2019) closed a multi-$10M Series B — second raise in a year (4 rounds total) — for new markets, infra, and service stack. TH/VN/ID/PH/MY; official partner of multiple SEA platforms. 146 owned Lazada shops
author: Unique Research
html:
Unique Research · Company / Funding · August 19, 2022

On Aug 17, 2022, SEA ecom full-stack vendor Laizanbao Group (来赞宝) (founded 2019) closed a multi-$10M Series B — second raise in a year (4 rounds total) — for new markets, infra, and service stack. TH/VN/ID/PH/MY; official partner of multiple SEA platforms. 146 owned Lazada shops (apparel, shoes, home, 3C…); 1688 + contracted factories; brand agency for Handu Yishe, Chuda Huang, SKG, Xiyu Meinong, Okamoto… Xiaomi Youpin shop → Lazada Level 7 in 1 month; I ANGEL → 3C category #1 in 1.5 months. Services: hosted ops, FB/IG digital marketing, localized CS, China consolidation → trunk → overseas warehouse → last mile. SEA ecom $120B ’21 → $234B ’25 (18% CAGR; Google/Bain/Temasek); China→ASEAN CBEC export +98.5% YTD’22.

— END —
